connection_condition: tab02.fld008 and tab01.fld008 share the same disease vocabulary; tab02 spells Sjogren syndrome as 'SJS' while tab01 spells it as 'SjS', and BEHCET/Behcet case varies.
description: Both fields represent a rheumatic disease diagnosis label; they differ in grain (patient-level versus event-level) and in spelling variants.
SLE diagnosis is a specific category of patient diagnosis; its value domain is a subset of diagnosis labels.
RA diagnosis is a specific category of patient diagnosis; its value domain is a subset of diagnosis labels.
APS diagnosis is a specific category of patient diagnosis; its value domain is a subset of diagnosis labels.

connection_condition: Age uses tab02.fld015 as its only input.
description: Age is derived as the current calendar year minus the year of the birthday.
A percentage is derived from a part count and a whole count of patients or patient records; the whole count is the denominator and the result is multiplied by 100.
The male-to-female ratio is derived from counts of patients by sex.
The decrease rate compares an earlier and a later total cholesterol measurement, using the later value as the denominator.

connection_condition: tab02.fld014 identifies the patient sex for each laboratory record through tab03.fld001.
description: Uric acid reference limits are sex-specific (higher upper limit for males); sex must be considered when judging normality.
The examination count is derived by counting the laboratory records that belong to a patient.
